baseline_models.focus_anchor: The reflexive speech verb at word 2, its 'upon/against Us' complement, and the partitive object at words 4-5.
baseline_models.mechanism: The speech branch supplies false saying or false attribution, while the part branch makes the object a separated portion. The counterfactual therefore tests whether even a portion of the discourse is falsely attached to its claimed source, not merely whether a wholly invented rival text appears.

activation_trace.role: False saying or attribution identifies the prohibited speech act as attaching unsaid material to the source.
Partition into portions makes 'some' a bounded segment whose small scope does not erase the breach.

changed_reading.before: He might invent some statements.
changed_reading.after: He might falsely attach even one partitioned segment of the sayings to Us.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The plural sayings at word 5 are governed by a fabrication verb and narrowed by 'some' at word 4.
baseline_models.mechanism: The circulating-talk branch turns the plural sayings into a social discourse already capable of travel. A fabricated portion can therefore contaminate a public stream without replacing the whole stream.

activation_trace.role: Talk circulating among people supplies a propagation medium for the fabricated portion.
A divided portion supplies the contaminating unit within a larger discourse.

changed_reading.before: The verse imagines an isolated false utterance.
changed_reading.after: The verse imagines inserting a false segment into a body of sayings that can circulate socially.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The construction joins the speech verb directly to the relational phrase 'upon/against Us.'
baseline_models.mechanism: A root branch associates speech with arrogating judgment over another. Although the branch is form-distant, the relational complement activates a reading in which fabricated attribution is an attempted seizure of the source's authority, not only a factual lie.

activation_trace.role: Arrogated judgment supplies the authority trespass latent in speaking upon the source.
A chief whose word has force supplies the link between attributed speech and operative authority.

changed_reading.before: Fabrication is a lie about wording.
changed_reading.after: Fabrication is also a bid to exercise the source's word-force without delegation.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The object explicitly says 'some' while both the verb and plural object carry the split speech-root citation.
baseline_models.mechanism: The non-dominant mapped branch of fewness resonates with the explicit partitive. This does not replace the speech sense; it exposes a possible minimizing frame in which an agent treats the added material as too little to count, while the condition counts any portion.

activation_trace.role: Fewness and smallness supply the agent's possible minimization of the forged increment.
A portion gives that minimization a direct grammatical anchor in the focus verse.

changed_reading.before: Some sayings is only an indefinite quantity.
changed_reading.after: Some sayings may stage the attempted excuse that the counterfeit increment is merely little.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The repeated speech root at words 2 and 5 also resolves to a non-dominant branch of unstable motion.
baseline_models.mechanism: The split mapping activates a material contrast inside the focus verse: fabricated attribution is speech made to move without a stable place in its claimed source. The direct false-attribution branch keeps this from becoming free phonetic association.

activation_trace.role: Rattling and lack of settled place supply a material image for source-unstable speech.
False attribution anchors the instability specifically in a forged source claim.

changed_reading.before: The false sayings are wrong in content.
changed_reading.after: The false sayings also rattle loose from the source in which they claim to be fixed.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context first assigns the qawl to a messenger, then excludes poet and soothsayer as producer roles, and finally gives the discourse a downward origin. The focus counterfactual becomes a route-integrity test: the bearer may voice what descends but may not switch from transmission to origination and attribute the product upward.

activation_trace.role: False attribution supplies the focus violation whose route the context specifies.
Uttered speech identifies qawl as the payload voiced in the messenger construction.
Messenger and message supply the delegated bearer role rather than an originating author role.
Poetic composition supplies one explicitly excluded mode of producing the discourse.
Claiming hidden reports supplies the second explicitly excluded mode of origination.
Caused descent and delivery establish the direction from source to bearer.

structural_cues: 69:40-43 repeats qawl, assigns one bearer, rejects two producer categories, and then states descent.
69:44 immediately reverses the direction with a hypothetical attribution upon the source.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies role labels and a descent sequence; I supply the arrow that these form a provenance chain whose reversal defines fabrication. A live alternative is that the sequence only distinguishes genres without modeling transmission.

changed_reading.before: The bearer might tell a lie about God.
changed_reading.after: The entrusted bearer might breach the source route by originating material and sending the attribution back toward the source.

context_deltas.mechanism: A focus branch images drawing a saying to oneself; the context supplies message-bearing and downward delivery. Together they activate an appropriation model: fabrication would pull entrusted speech into private authorship and reissue it as though it still came from above.

activation_trace.role: Drawing a saying to oneself supplies the appropriation step inside the focus speech act.
Messenger and message supply material held in a delegated rather than proprietary capacity.
Delivery downward supplies the original direction that self-appropriation would reverse.

structural_cues: The messenger's qawl precedes descent from the Lord, then the focus changes to a reflexive fabrication verb.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies entrusted delivery plus a focus image of pulling speech to oneself; I infer a transfer from custody into claimed authorship and a return attribution. The simpler live alternative is ordinary lying with no appropriation sequence.

changed_reading.before: Fabrication means composing an untrue sentence.
changed_reading.after: Fabrication may be the self-appropriation of entrusted speech followed by laundering it back under the source's name.

context_deltas.mechanism: The non-dominant fewness activation in the focus is made audible by the two explicit 'little' refrains immediately before it. Yet littleness attaches there to audience belief and remembrance, while in the focus even 'some' forged sayings trigger the condition. The quantities become asymmetrical: human response can be little; tolerated counterfeit content is zero.

activation_trace.role: The split-root image of fewness makes minimization latent inside the focus speech forms.
A portion anchors the focus side of the quantitative contrast.
Explicit fewness supplies the first nearby refrain of deficient audience response.

1. **False attribution precisely distinguished from transmitted speech.** Doubled **ق و ل B005** (false saying or false attribution) is activated by the form `تقول`, after **ق و ل B001** named genuine utterance in 69:40. reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Fabrication is speech drawn to oneself from another source.** `ق و ل` B005 is "false saying or false attribution" and B006 is "drawing a saying to oneself." The reflexive form `تَقَوَّلَ` follows the explicit source `مِّن رَّبِّ` and is followed by seizure from the hypothetical speaker in 69:45-46. B006 assigns appropriation; B005 assigns false attribution. The packet supplies authorized source and counterfactual reassignment; I infer source theft -> attributional falsehood. The line reads as a precise breach of transmission custody, not generic lying.
2. **Even a portion triggers whole-body enforcement.** `ب ع ض` B001 is "parting a thing into portions." The counterfactual concerns `بَعْضَ ٱلْأَقَاوِيلِ`, yet the consequence seizes the person, cuts the life-vein, and admits no barrier in 69:45-47. B001 assigns limited scope to the fabricated content; the following body sequence supplies total scope to enforcement. The packet gives part/whole asymmetry; I infer that source-integrity is non-divisible, so partial corruption breaches the whole trust. `بَعْضَ` therefore intensifies rather than mitigates the offense.
3. **The false speaker would arrogate judgment as well as wording.** `ق و ل` B010 is "arrogating judgment over someone." The preceding speech defines accountability, and the hypothetical would insert sayings `عَلَيْنَا`, against the named divine source. B010 assigns the fabricated sayings an authority-claim: the speaker would not only coin words but claim the right to determine what binds hearers. The packet supplies authoritative descent and binding consequences; I infer invented wording -> usurped jurisdiction. The ayah reads as a sovereignty breach in speech.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 69:51's firm truth confirms why even `بَعْضَ` fabrication cannot be absorbed as harmless variation: `ح ق ق` B001/B010 presents a tightly made, reality-matching whole. Then 69:52 replaces false saying with proper naming and praise. The retrospective reveals a speech reversal: arrogated words are cut off; correctly sourced designation is commanded.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynakların çoğunluk çizgisi tekil ve topluluk adında sivrisinek kimliğini destekler. Kaynak ifadesi ayrıca yazın ısırma zararını, bir topluluğa zarar vermeyi ve bir yerde çokça bulunmayı bu dalda verir. Bununla birlikte bir kaynak topluluk adını tahtakurusu olarak açıklar; küçük gövdeye dayandırılan sözcük açıklaması ise böceğin kimliğinin yerine geçmeyen bağımlı bir kaynak yorumudur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dalın ana çekirdeği sivrisinektir, ancak bir kaynak topluluk biçimini tahtakurusu olarak açıklar; zarar verme ve bir yerde bulunma anlamları yalnızca belirtilen türemiş biçim ve söz kalıplarında geçerlidir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Sivrisineği adlandıran yalın biçimler ile zarar, çokluk ve bir yerde bulunma bildiren kalıba bağlı kullanımlar ayrı tutulur; ikinciler genel bir yalın kök anlamına dönüştürülmez.

concept_map.definition: Sivrisineği tekil veya topluluk halinde belirtir. Bir kaynak topluluk adını tahtakurusu olarak açıklar. Başka bir kaynak yazın ısırarak verdiği zararı vurgular; belirli türemiş biçimler sivrisineklerin bir topluluğa zarar vermesini ya da bir gece veya yerde çokça bulunmasını anlatır; bir kaynak açıklaması da adı böceğin gövde küçüklüğüyle ilişkilendirir.

facets.statement: Tekil veya topluluk halinde sivrisineği adlandırır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Isıran sivrisineği ve onun bir yerde bulunması veya insanlara zarar vermesiyle ilgili türemiş kullanımları kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Yüzü kaplayan, sivrisineğe benzetilen fakat ısırmadığı belirtilen başka bir küçük zararlıyı veya onun eziyetini kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da insanı rahatsız eden sivrisinek benzeri küçük canlılar alanında buluşur.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal gerçek sivrisineği ve ısırmasına bağlı zararı belirtir; komşu dal ise yüze üşüşen ancak ısırmayan benzer bir canlıyı ayırır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Belirli olarak sivrisineği, ısırma zararını ve sivrisinek varlığına bağlı türemiş anlamları gösterir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Küçük kara hayvanlarının ve birbirinden farklı küçük canlıların geniş bir üst sınıfını kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal küçük canlılar ve böcekler alanında kullanılabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Komşu dal geniş ve türce karışık bir küçük canlılar sınıfıdır; odak dalın göndergesi ise sivrisinekle sınırlıdır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Uçan ve ısıran sivrisineği, ayrıca onun zararını ve bir yerde bulunmasını belirtir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Bitleri ve saçta, ekinde veya başka ortamlarda bulunan çeşitli küçük canlıları kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da insanı veya çevresini etkileyebilen küçük canlıları adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal sivrisinek türüne bağlıdır; komşu dal bit ve ona benzetilen başka küçük canlılardan oluşan ayrı, daha geniş bir kümeyi gösterir.

scoping.note: SCOPED, NOT ABSENT. A root listed in dropped_roots is a deliberate scoping decision, not a missing source.
